card.name: Inside long split-up words
card.fires_on: Fires on a middle piece of a longer word that is split into parts, such as the SC in adolescents, the as in extravasation, or the yme in Lyme. It is strongest in medical words like adolescents and extravasation.

modes.label: Adolescents
